keepPolicy.preferredFolder: The one in the preferred folder

categories.intro: Döndü sorts files into these categories. The AI also chooses only from this list.
categories.resetBody: Categories you added are removed and the defaults come back.

onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.intro: Döndü understands your messy folders, proposes a tidy layout and applies it only after you approve. Nothing is deleted; everything can be undone.
onboarding.s2: How should we understand your files?

none.title: Rules only
none.body: Free and offline. Puts most files in the right place.

anthropic.title: Claude
anthropic.body: Fast and very good. About 1 cent per 50 files; needs an API key.

lmstudio.title: LM Studio
lmstudio.body: Runs on your computer, free; slower.

onboarding.keyHint: The key is stored encrypted in the system keychain. You can also enter it later in Settings.
onboarding.lmHint: Open LM Studio, load a model and start the server with Developer → Start Server. Pick the model in Settings → AI.
onboarding.checkEmpty: Once you add folders I will check read and write access here.
onboarding.fixFirst: First fix or remove folders that cannot be read.

mac-tcc.title: macOS did not allow access to this folder
mac-tcc.intro: Granting Full Disk Access once is the smoothest way; otherwise I will ask for permission per selected folder.
steps: Press "Open Full Disk Access settings" below.
Find Döndü in the list and turn it on (add it from Applications with + if needed).
Go back to Folders and press "Try again".

mac-gatekeeper.title: "Developer cannot be verified" or "damaged" warning
mac-gatekeeper.intro: Döndü is not yet signed by Apple. This warning appears once.
steps: In Applications, right-click Dondu, choose Open, then Open again.
If that does not work, open Terminal (Applications → Utilities → Terminal).
Paste the command below, press Enter, then open Döndü as usual.

win-cfa.title: Windows Security is blocking writes to this folder
win-cfa.intro: With Ransomware protection (Controlled folder access) on, writes to Documents, Pictures and Desktop are silently blocked.
steps: Go to Virus & threat protection → Ransomware protection → Manage ransomware protection.
Allow an app through Controlled folder access → Add an allowed app → choose Dondu.exe.
Go back to Folders and press "Try again".

win-smartscreen.title: "Windows protected your PC" warning
win-smartscreen.intro: Döndü's installer is not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen warns about it.

cloud.title: Files that live in the cloud
cloud.intro: With iCloud Drive or OneDrive "files on demand", some files exist only in the cloud, not on this computer. Döndü leaves them alone.
steps: In the report they appear in the "In the cloud, not downloaded" group and are skipped.
To include them, right-click in Finder or File Explorer and choose "Download now" / "Always keep on this device".
